mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating signal, defined by a 0.5 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months, indicates a weakening job market that triggers risk-off sentiment and reduces corporate hiring, leading to lower earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past 2 months signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for two consecutive months indicates a weakening in real economic output, which increases recession risk and triggers equity market sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO is below its 12-month MA for 2 months, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that increases the likelihood of future rate hikes, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS stable (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong expansion in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) signals robust private demand, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS and HOUST rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 in a single month, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS < 50k and UNRATE is rising, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past 6 months, combined with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), indicates a healthy, non-inflationary growth environment that supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% YoY and CPIAUCSL < 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
